title: 1984 Hosting cyberattack and shutdown, Nov 2026

subject.name: 1984 Hosting
subject.about: 1984 Hosting (1984 ehf) is an Icelandic hosting company. It runs websites, virtual private servers, email and domain name services for its customers, and Iceland lists it as an operator of essential services.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by 1984 Hosting, CERT-IS, Icelandic authorities, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One hosting company and the customers whose websites, email and servers it runs. It has not said how many customers it has; its managing director says most are outside Iceland.
who_is_affected: 1984's customers: their services were suspended on Nov 20. Email is back and most virtual servers are online; shared-hosting websites are due back from the night of Nov 26. 1984 says their data was not touched except on seven targeted websites.

known.text: 1984 Hosting says attackers got into parts of its infrastructure in a targeted cyberattack, and it suspended its services to contain it.
1984 says customer data was not seen or changed, except on seven websites that were the original target.
Email is working again and about 80% of virtual servers are back; shared web hosting is due to start returning from 21:00 UTC on Nov 26.
Iceland activated its response plan for essential information infrastructure on Nov 25, citing AI-driven attacks.

not_known.text: Who was behind the attack. The company's managing director suspects a nation-state, but nobody official has said.
Which seven websites were attacked, and whether anything was taken from them.
Whether the attack is linked to the AI-driven attacks Iceland is on alert for.
